svg.title: Blot Goose K1 runtime versus main

cc:Work.dc:title: Blot Goose K1 runtime versus main
cc:Work.dc:description: K1 generic integer loop takes 1.20/1.13 times main runtime, generic F32 3.61/4.24 times, and generic pair 6.40/6.55 times, in default/optimizing-only V8. Ordinary loops are near parity.
